6499.title: Shared acknowledgement outages expire host leases
6499.rootCauseOneLine: Remote clients keep ticking during a server acknowledgement blackout and independently exceed the advertised 30-second lease; tunnel-local stall grace does not renew those leases.
6499.proposedFix: Choose a coordinated liveness budget only after isolated multi-process origin-stall and tunnel-reset tests; profile and remove the origin's blocking workload.
6499.caveats: Two clean runs reproduce synchronized client lease expiry, not the original CPU stall, Cloudflare reset, or HTTP error chain. Full reproduction code is inline because the reports repository forbids committed test and log artifacts. No simple-fix PR is safe.
